description: Copy an existing public help center (Zendesk, Intercom, HelpScout, etc.) into the Weav Help Center knowledge base. The Help Center stays private until the user goes live. Only works while the Weav Help Center is empty and not live. Check progress with kb_import_status. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

instructions.description: Optional notes for the import, for example which sections to skip.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

url.description: Public URL of the existing help center, for example help.acme.com.

name: kb_start_import
title: Import an existing help center
